title: Hyundai Sonata (2011-13) and Elantra (2011-14): airbag light, B134600 / B148100, clockspring covered 15 years
summary: Hyundai bulletin 26-BE-022H (warranty extension TXXA): driver airbag high-resistance codes from a failing clock spring. Coverage is 15 years, unlimited miles, from original delivery; the fix is a new clock spring, 93490-3X040.

specs.name: DTCs
specs.value: B134600 driver airbag 1st stage resistance high; B148100 driver airbag 2nd stage high

specs.name: Warranty extension
specs.value: 15 years, unlimited miles, from original retail delivery or first use (TXXA)

steps.text: Scan with GDS for B134600 and B148100. Neither set: diagnose normally; the bulletin doesn't apply.
Either set: replace the clock spring per the shop manual with 93490-3X040. Keep a photo of the old clock spring or a screenshot of the stored code; the warranty claim needs one.

body: Vehicles in the bulletin: 2011-2013 Sonata (YFA) and Sonata Hybrid (YF HEV); 2011-2014 Elantra (MD), Elantra (UD) and Elantra Coupe (JK). The production-date columns don't line up with the models in the PDF text, so they're left out; check the VIN with a Hyundai dealer. The Elantra GT and Elantra Touring aren't in the bulletin and are excluded here.

sources.title: Technical Service Bulletin 26-BE-022H: Clock Spring - DTC B134600 & B148100 (Warranty Extension TXXA)
